keyPoints: Sparsh rekha (tangent) vritt ko sirf ek bindu par chhooti hai — us bindu ko sparsh bindu kehte hain.
Sparsh bindu par trijya sparsh rekha par lamb hoti hai — ye sabse zaroori gun hai — isi se adhiktar prameya siddh hote hain.
Vritt ke bahar ke bindu se do sparsh rekhaen kheenchi ja sakti hain, aur dono ki lambai barabar hoti hai — ye sparsh rekhaon ka mukhya prameya hai.
Sparsh rekhaon ke sawalon me trijya jod kar samkon tribhuj banao — phir Pythagoras lagao; trijya, sparsh rekha aur kendra-bindu doori se tribhuj banta hai.
Sakendriya vritton me badi trijya wali jya chhote vritt ko sparsh kare to woh samdvibhajit hoti hai.
Sparsh bindu par bana kon aur kendra se trijya — inka 90 ka sambandh har prameya me kaam aata hai.
Aam galti: sparsh rekha ko chhedak (secant) samajhna — chhedak vritt ko do binduon par kaatti hai, sparsh ek par.
subject: Maths
title: Vritt ki Sparsh Rekha
